title: Couples Fertility and Pregnancy Awareness
brief_summary: Recent evidence has shown that young people that want to have children have low fertility knowledge. This study evaluates the efficacy of a video intervention on fertility knowledge, on changes in lifestyle and on the decision to start to get pregnant.
raw_criteria:
Inclusion Criteria:

* Female member of the couples has between 24 to 40 years
* Childless couples trying to conceive or couples who desired to have children in the next 3 years
* Relationship length minimum of one year

Exclusion Criteria:

* Couples that already had achieved a successful pregnancy
* Couples with children
